File.DescribedExactlyWhenCreated.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[
					s.status === "",
					s.filename === "",
					s.content_type === "",
					s.sha256 === "",
					s.size === 0,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.filename !== "", s.content_type !== "", s.sha256 !== ""].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

File.ContentNeverChanges.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				[
					after.filename === before.filename,
					after.content_type === before.content_type,
					after.size === before.size,
					after.sha256 === before.sha256,
					after.origin_session_id === before.origin_session_id,
					after.origin_turn === before.origin_turn,
					after.origin_path === before.origin_path,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

File.ReservationsAreNumberedInOrder.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				after.reservations === before.reservations,
				[command._tag === "ReserveFile", after.reservations === before.reservations + 1].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

File.AnOriginNamesASessionATurnAndAPathO.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.origin_session_id === "", s.origin_turn === 0, s.origin_path === ""].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					s.status !== "",
					s.origin_session_id !== "",
					s.origin_turn >= 1,
					s.origin_path !== "",
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

SessionOutputs.AnOutcomeIsRecordedExactl.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.turn === 0, s.outcome === "", s.files === "", s.skipped === ""].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.turn >= 1, s.outcome !== ""].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

SessionOutputs.ATurnIsRecordedAtMostOnce.source:
({ before, after, command, events }) =>
			[
				[events.length === 0, command.turn <= before.turn].every((ok) => ok),
				[events.length === 1, command.turn > before.turn, after.turn === command.turn].every(
					(ok) => ok,
				),
			].some((ok) => ok)

SessionOutputs.ASkippedTurnKeepsTheFiles.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[command._tag !== "SkipSessionOutputs", after.files === before.files].some((ok) => ok)

SessionOutputs.NothingChangesWithoutARec.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			[
				events.length !== 0,
				[
					after.turn === before.turn,
					after.outcome === before.outcome,
					after.reason === before.reason,
					after.files === before.files,
					after.skipped === before.skipped,
					after.recorded_at === before.recorded_at,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)
